d: Launched in Bahrain in November of 2019, Calo is on a mission to make healthy easy. We’re a team of dedicated people driving this mission by providing better, faster, and cheaper ways to access food through technology.

We are looking for a Commis Chef to join our Calo team. The Commis Chef will support the kitchen team with basic food preparation and daily kitchen operations while maintaining Calo’s hygiene, safety, and quality standards.

The successful candidate will assist with tasks such as chopping, slicing, portioning, cleaning, ingredient handling, and supporting chefs, stewards, and kitchen helpers to ensure smooth kitchen operations. This role is ideal for someone eager to grow within a fast-paced kitchen environment and gain hands-on culinary experience.
For this role, we are seeking candidates with experience in hospitality, restaurants, central kitchens, or food production environments.
Works under the guidance of senior chefs, CDPs, and kitchen supervisors
Supports kitchen operations alongside stewards, kitchen helpers, and production staff
Works closely with Kitchen Management and Production Leads to maintain workflow efficiency
Shift-based work in temperature-controlled environments with mandatory personal protective equipment during all production operation times
Assist with basic food preparation including chopping, slicing, peeling, trimming, and portioning ingredients
Support chefs with mise en place and ingredient preparation as per standardized recipes
Assist with receiving, storing, labeling, and rotating ingredients following FIFO practices
Help maintain cleanliness and organization of kitchen stations, storage areas, and preparation areas
Support stewards and kitchen helpers with cleaning duties and maintaining sanitation standards
Ensure preparation tasks are completed efficiently and on time to support production and dispatch operations
Follow food safety, hygiene, and HACCP standards at all times
Assist in minimizing waste through proper handling and storage of ingredients
Support the kitchen team during busy operational periods and maintain teamwork across all sections
Carry out any additional kitchen support duties assigned by senior chefs or supervisors
Previous experience in restaurants, hotels, catering, central kitchens, or food production environments preferred
Basic understanding of food hygiene and kitchen safety standards
HACCP knowledge or certification is an advantage
Basic understanding of kitchen operations and food preparation techniques
Ability to work in a fast-paced and high-volume kitchen environment
Ability to follow instructions and work well within a team
Positive attitude and willingness to learn
Team player with good work ethic
Passion for food preparation and kitchen operations
Ability to maintain cleanliness, organization, and discipline in the kitchen
Committed to supporting the team and delivering quality standards consistently

Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.
q: Minimum of 6 years of professional experience in internal audit and/or industry internal controls.
Working experience of Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) requirements with good understanding of Internal Controls Over Financial Reporting including both process/business controls and IT controls.
Experience with using agentic engineering to test controls, prepare documentation and perform analysis.
Background in crypto, fintech, or related financial services sectors is highly beneficial.
Experience in both large publicly listed organizations (e.g., on the USA or UK stock exchanges) and high-growth scale-ups or startups preparing for listing is an advantage.
Experience in external audit is a plus.
Professional certifications such as CPA, CIA, or CISA are preferred.
Hands-on experience with GRC systems; familiarity with AuditBoard is an advantage.
Strong communication skills; multilingual candidates will be given additional consideration.
Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams without the need for travel.
Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy
Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
Remote-first, work-from-home arrangement (may vary depending on the nature of the role and team)

r: Conduct comprehensive internal control reviews to identify risks and recommend improvements.
Support regulatory examinations and respond to external audit inquiries effectively.
Monitor internal control issues and actions, partnering with action owners to ensure timely closure of findings.
Maintain and utilize Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) systems—experience with AuditBoard is a plus.
Collaborate across functions and teams to promote a strong risk and control culture.
Assist in continuous improvement of internal control processes and documentation.
